outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
The bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity displays the individual data points (blue dots for No Cre, n=5; red dots for Ad-Cre, n=3) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
Panel C consists of histology/fluorescence images and spatial expression heatmaps (Cd68, Spp1), not a summary plot of averaged replicate measurements.
The GSEA enrichment plots show running enrichment scores derived from ranked gene lists, not an average of biological replicates that would require individual data points.

The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) comparing low pH vs high pH spatial transcriptomic regions. Each bar is a single computed statistic derived from large numbers of spots/cells rather than an average across a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not expected here.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a quantitative averaged plot.
